_doc: Key Themes registry (Macro › Key Themes; Jamie 10-28). One home for themes, signposts, scenarios and theme baskets. Claude maintains it in every market-thesis session (.agents/skills/fildi-market-thesis § Themes). Signpost kinds: chart (macro-charts cache series), fred (macro-data series field), revision (median LSEG 30-day EPS drift of a basket, %), flow (basket market-cap change minus whole-universe change, pp), cds (LSEG 5y CDS bp: level or change), gov (Treasury cash flows), manual (value typed here with as_of; stale after stale_days). bull_if / bear_if = [op, value]; neither → neutral. share_overrides = company-wide share count for dual-class names priced on one line (GOOGL = A+B+C, BRK.B in B-equivalents; approximate, re-check yearly). Thresholds are judgment calls labelled as such, not fitted — grading lives in theme_snapshots + LOG.md.

themes.name: AI capex super-cycle
themes.thesis: Hyperscaler capex (~$700–800 B in 2026, > $1 T consensus 2027) keeps flowing to suppliers: chips, memory, optics, power.

view.text: Demand is real; money lands on suppliers, not spenders (A293).

themes.name: AI financing & credit
themes.thesis: The risk is the cost of money, not demand: debt-funded builders (neoclouds, ORCL) are the weak link, as in telecom 2000.

themes.name: Expensive market × rising rates
themes.thesis: CAPE ~41 is survivable; CAPE > 30 with the 10y up ≥ 75 bp in 12 m is the one historically bad mix (median −2 %, S122).

view.text: ~45 % odds of a ≥ 10 % drawdown first, even with a bullish 12 m view.

themes.name: Inflation & the Fed
themes.thesis: Fed hiked in Sept (first since 2023). 1997 vs 2000/2018 split = whether the Fed keeps hiking.

view.text: One-and-done is the A-path; a Dec hike moves weight to B.

themes.thesis: FY26 deficit ~$2 T keeps cash flowing, but $1.1 T is interest paid to bond holders; TGA rebuilds drain reserves.

view.text: Stimulative in dollars; the twist is who receives it.
